name: M3_PPS200MI_LstLine
description: List purchase order lines for a specific purchase order and return detailed information per line and subline. The response includes identifiers, item and supplier data, ordered and received quantities, prices and discounts, logistics dates and locations, tax and costing information, references to related orders, and user‑defined fields. The standard item name, purchase order item name, and purchase order item description fields are not returned in full length in this operation. For the complete contents of these text fields, use the complementary list that exposes them in full length (LstLine2).

inputParameters.name: PUNO
inputParameters.description: Purchase order number whose lines will be listed.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number to use when searching for the purchase order; defaults to the logged-in company.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company number that owns the purchase order.

outputParameters.name: PUNO
outputParameters.description: Purchase order number.

outputParameters.name: PNLI
outputParameters.description: Purchase order line number.

outputParameters.name: PNLS
outputParameters.description: Purchase order line suffix identifying a split of the line.

outputParameters.name: ITNO
outputParameters.description: Item number on the purchase order line.

outputParameters.name: SITE
outputParameters.description: Supplier’s own item number for the line.

outputParameters.name: CODT
outputParameters.description: Confirmed delivery date agreed with the supplier for this line.

outputParameters.name: CFQA
outputParameters.description: Confirmed quantity for the line in the purchase unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: PUUN
outputParameters.description: Unit of measure in which the ordered quantity on the line is expressed.

outputParameters.name: ITDS
outputParameters.description: Item name for the ordered item, truncated in this list view.

outputParameters.name: EACD

outputParameters.name: FACI

outputParameters.name: WHLO
